criteria.text: Identifies that the Redcliffe Retail Group plc contract (Clause 14.2) allows termination on a change of control without consent, that the disclosure against Warranty 6.3 says there is no such provision, and that consent should be obtained as a condition to Closing.
Identifies that the warranty cap in SPA Section 8.4 is stated as $6,750,000 but 12% of the $45,000,000 Purchase Price is $5,400,000, i.e. the stated figure is wrong.
Calculates the Earn-out Payment as $1,600,000 (2 x ($7,300,000 - $6,500,000), subject to the $3,000,000 cap) and identifies that the Seller's figure of $2,200,000 is wrong.

Identifies the conflict between the 30-day claim notice period in SPA Section 9.7 and the 60-day period in Escrow Clause 5.2, and recommends the Buyer works to the shorter 30-day period or aligns the documents.
Shows the arithmetic for the cap (12% x $45,000,000 = $5,400,000) and flags the discrepancy with the stated $6,750,000.
Shows proposed drafting changes as before/after (current wording vs proposed wording) with a one-line rationale.
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
